welcome.text: Your night shift at Eerie Springs Gas begins. Follow the objective list.

movement.text: WASD to move · Mouse to look

flashlight.text: Press F to toggle your flashlight

clock_in.text: Walk to the register and press E on the timecard to clock in

manager_note.text: Press E to read the manager's note taped by the register

chores.text: Complete chores from your objective list when customers aren't waiting

scanner.text: Left-click to scan items with your hand scanner

register_total.text: The register shows the total. Take the customer's cash, then make correct change.

make_change.text: Click bills/coins to give change until the drawer shows $0.00 owed.

pump_customer.text: A customer is at the pumps — help them from the register pump panel or go outside.

cooler_alarm.text: Cooler alarm! Go behind the coolers and press E on the alarm box to shut it off.

hints_toggle.text: Press H or use Settings to turn hints on/off.
